content: Hi! I can help you use the appointment manager. What would you like to do?
How do I book an appointment?

I could not reach the OpenAI assistant right now, so I used the local appointment helper instead. Use the Book Appointment page from the sidebar. Choose a future date, pick an available time, enter symptoms, then click Book Now.
how do i delete an appointment?

I could not reach the OpenAI assistant right now, so I used the local appointment helper instead. Use Delete Appointments from the sidebar. Select the appointment, review the details, check the confirmation box, then click Cancel Appointment.
